name: router-jev
description: Room router backed by TypeSafe's Jev: when a room post addresses nobody, one System One request decides which agent leads the reply and who else should chime in

setup.title: Get a TypeSafe API key
setup.detail: Create an API key in your TypeSafe account. It stays on this machine and is sent only to api.typesafe.ai.

setup.title: Choose the rooms that use it
setup.detail: Connecting sends nothing. A room's text goes to TypeSafe only after its owner sets that room's router to "jev". Every other room keeps the built-in mentions router, which runs offline.

form.label: TypeSafe API key
form.help: Used only for rooms whose router is set to jev.
